- [N-000780](../../../sdd/specs/vision.md#L43) ✗ Language judgment belongs to a model, in small closed questions.
- [N-000781](../../../sdd/specs/vision.md#L43) ✗ The model answers narrow, schema-bound questions — "what claims are in this paragraph?", "do these two contradict?" — never open ones.
- [N-000782](../../../sdd/specs/vision.md#L45) ✗ Every answer is checked by code before it is accepted, and recorded so a rebuild replays it instead of asking again.
- [N-000787](../../../sdd/specs/vision.md#L49) ✗ A collapsed form for humans and a full-detail form for AI agents, both derived from the same records, so they cannot disagree.
- [N-000800](../../../sdd/specs/vision.md#L74) ✗ Nothing enters the graph without a quote from the source.
